hold_text: This PR bundles two checklist rows (C1, E6). C1's diff (scripts/ci/check_research_queue_decision_rule.py, scripts/ci/run_guards.py, research/queue/README.md) is inside TIER1_SURFACE and would self-land on its own. E6(b)'s diff (scripts/ml/replay_pregate_fleet.py) is Tier-1 by the canonical doc's own description -- research/analysis tooling, no order path, no config, no deploy -- but is not on pr-landing-guard's narrow TIER1_SURFACE allowlist (only scripts/ci/**, scripts/ops/**, scripts/research/**, scripts/reports/**, scripts/backtest_*.py are, not scripts/ml/**). Bundling means the whole PR holds for one human read rather than only the E6(b) file. Both changes are correctness-neutral: the C1 guard is diff-scoped and grandfathers every existing unit (verified: 6 of 18 units grandfathered, 0 new-unit failures), and the E6(b) fix is `del` of two now-unused references plus a per-head `gc.collect()` -- neither can change a computed value.
why: C1: adds decision_rule to the research-queue schema plus a diff-scoped CI guard, docs + CI only. E6(a): the TIER1_SURFACE gap was already fixed by E57 (#12857, merged before this session started); this session merged main into the freshest stuck replay-pregate PR (#12815) so it picked up that fix, confirmed CI now passes, and it merged. The 12 older duplicate PRs were closed as superseded. E6(b): diagnosed the trainer swap-thrashing (6/6 nightly runs dying at head 10 of 22, always the same head, always mid-BTC) as cumulative per-head memory growth inside the fleet harness itself -- not a trainer-runtime/service change -- and shipped the harness-only fix.
